title: Nat Geo 9: Antoni
titleZh: 安東尼・波羅斯基回答國家地理 9 問
scene: 廚師兼主持人安東尼・波羅斯基在黃色椅子上回答 9 個問題，聊童年建議、想去的地方、最愛的食物和人生感悟。

video.title: Antoni Porowski Answers the Nat Geo 9 | Yellow Chair Interview | National Geographic

lines.en: I'm Anthony Porowski and I'm the host of Best of the World and I'm here to answer the Nat Geo
lines.zh: 我是安東尼・波羅斯基，《Best of the World》的主持人，今天來回答國家地理的 9 個問題。
9 個問題。

lines.en: You won't be lactose intolerant forever.
lines.zh: 你不會一輩子都乳糖不耐。

lines.en: It's okay if you cry at songs like Don't Look Back in Anger by Oasis.
lines.zh: 聽到綠洲合唱團的〈Don't Look Back in Anger〉會哭，沒關係。

lines.en: Your sensitivity will serve you later in life.
lines.zh: 你的敏感，以後在人生裡會派上用場。

lines.en: Even if all of your classmates make fun of you right now.
lines.zh: 就算現在全班同學都在取笑你。

lines.en: Okay, first would be Joan Didion followed by Jack Kerouac, Saint-Exupéry, James Dean, my partner, my dog Neon, my best friend Remo who I haven't seen in a really long time.
lines.zh: 好，第一個是瓊・蒂蒂安，接著是傑克・凱魯亞克、聖修伯里、詹姆斯・狄恩、我的伴侶、我的狗 Neon、還有我很久沒見的摯友雷莫。

lines.en: Oh, oh, and my dog Carbo who I had when I lived in West Virginia when I was a kid.
lines.zh: 喔，還有我的狗 Carbo，我小時候住在西維吉尼亞時養的。

lines.en: I've barely scratched the surface on Africa.
lines.zh: 非洲我連皮毛都還沒摸到。

lines.en: I've only been to Senegal, South Africa, and Botswana.
lines.zh: 我只去過塞內加爾、南非和波札那。

lines.en: So, I have a lot to explore.
lines.zh: 所以還有很多地方可以探索。

lines.en: And then Asia, I mean there's so much to see.
lines.zh: 還有亞洲，我是說真的有太多可以看了。

lines.en: But then also I've never been to the Nordic countries.
lines.zh: 但我也從沒去過北歐國家。

lines.en: So, I need to go visit there.
lines.zh: 所以我得去那邊走走。

lines.en: And I have to go to Antarctica, obviously.
lines.zh: 當然，我也一定要去南極。

lines.en: It's a very hard answer.
lines.zh: 這很難回答。

lines.en: I just finished taking my dog on a walk and then I come home and dinner's ready.
lines.zh: 我剛帶狗散完步，回到家晚餐就準備好了。

lines.en: Maybe like a nice bolognese with some fresh pappardelle.
lines.zh: 也許是一份不錯的波隆那肉醬，配上新鮮的寬麵條。

lines.en: And then get on the couch, watch some like really good animal doc or some natural history show or something
lines.zh: 然後窩在沙發上，看一部很棒的動物紀錄片，或自然史節目之類的，

lines.en: historical and light up all the candles and I'm nice and cozy and I have my blanket on me and then I'm just waiting for it to hit 8:00 p.m.
lines.zh: 或歷史類的輕鬆節目，把所有蠟燭點亮，舒舒服服地蓋著毯子，然後就等著晚上 8 點到來，

lines.en: so I can start to get ready for bed.
lines.zh: 這樣我就能開始準備上床睡覺。

lines.en: Don't Look Back in Anger.
lines.zh: 〈Don't Look Back in Anger〉。

lines.en: Any and all cheese.
lines.zh: 任何一種起司都好。

lines.en: Maine blueberries when they're in season with whipped cream, not too sweet, maybe a little bit of mint on top,
lines.zh: 緬因州的藍莓，當季的時候，配上鮮奶油，不要太甜，上面也許放一點薄荷，

lines.en: why not?
lines.zh: 為什麼不呢？

lines.en: This Polish hunter's stew called bigos.
lines.zh: 這道波蘭獵人燉肉，叫做 bigos。

lines.en: And that's like with some rye bread and maybe like spread with a bit of marrow, maybe some like sautéed
lines.zh: 配上黑麥麵包，也許再抹一點骨髓，旁邊也許放些香煎

lines.en: chanterelles on the side.
lines.zh: 雞油菌菇。

lines.en: A really good risotto Milanese.
lines.zh: 一份很棒的米蘭燉飯。

lines.en: It's just loads of saffron in there with some osso buco in the middle.
lines.zh: 裡面放了大量的番紅花，中間再放一塊燉牛膝。

lines.en: I'm not terminally unique.
lines.zh: 我沒有那麼獨一無二。

lines.en: So, like whatever I'm going through, I'm not the only one in the world who's ever experienced it.
lines.zh: 所以不管我正在經歷什麼，我都不是世上唯一經歷過的人。

lines.en: The way I feel now is not how I'm going to feel forever.
lines.zh: 我現在的感受，不會是我永遠的感受。

lines.en: And one I've learned more recently is having difficult conversations with people who view the world very differently than me.
lines.zh: 而我最近學到的一件事，是跟世界觀和我非常不同的人進行困難的對話。

lines.en: It's not about adopting their belief system or even agreeing with them, but it's more about understanding where they are coming
lines.zh: 重點不是接受他們的信念，甚至不是同意他們，而是去理解他們是從哪裡來的，

lines.en: from and why they are the way they are.
lines.zh: 還有他們為什麼會是現在這個樣子。

lines.en: One of the My dogs, I haven't seen her in six whole hours.
lines.zh: 其中一個是，我的狗，我已經整整六個小時沒看到她了。

lines.en: The second would be I've never seen a cheetah in the wild.
lines.zh: 第二個是，我從來沒在野外看過獵豹。

lines.en: And I was obsessed with cheetahs as a kid, cuz they're the fastest land animal.
lines.zh: 我小時候超迷獵豹，因為牠們是跑最快的陸上動物。

lines.en: So, I really want to see one.
lines.zh: 所以我真的很想看到一隻。

lines.en: Ooh.
lines.zh: 喔。

lines.en: Actual person would be Saint Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, the author of The Little Prince.
lines.zh: 真實存在的人，會是聖修伯里，《小王子》的作者。

lines.en: That book was read to me in Polish when I was a little kid.
lines.zh: 小時候有人用波蘭文唸那本書給我聽。

lines.en: And then when I learned French in school, I read it in French.
lines.zh: 後來我在學校學了法文，就用法文讀了它。

lines.en: And then in English, I've read it maybe like a dozen times.
lines.zh: 然後英文版，我大概讀過十幾次。

lines.en: Whenever I'm really going through something in life, I go back and I'm reminded of what actually matters in life.
lines.zh: 每當我人生遇到難關，我就回頭去讀，提醒自己人生真正重要的是什麼。

lines.en: This is unreal.
lines.zh: 這太不真實了。

quiz.q: What does Antoni say about his sensitivity?
options: It will help him later in life
It stopped when he grew up
quiz.why: 他說你的敏感以後在人生裡會派上用場。

quiz.q: What would be his perfect evening at home?
options: Going out to a loud party
Dinner, a nature show, candles and a blanket
quiz.why: 他描述的是吃晚餐、看自然節目、點蠟燭、蓋毯子的舒服夜晚。

quiz.q: Why does he want to see a cheetah in the wild?
options: He was afraid of them as a kid
He was obsessed with them as a kid
quiz.why: 他說小時候很迷獵豹，因為牠們是跑最快的陸上動物。

adopting: 接受、採用（adopt 的進行式）
We are adopting a new process.
africa: He travels to Africa for work.
agreeing: She is agreeing with the plan.
animal: A cat is a small animal.
animals: We saw many animals at the zoo.
我們在動物園看到很多動物。
antoine: 安托萬寫了一本有名的書。
as: He left early as he was sick.
author: 名詞
作者
The author signed my book.
作者在我的書上簽名。
back: 回頭、回去（Don't Look Back 裡的 back）
bed: I go to bed at ten.
belief: Trust is a basic belief here.
信任是這裡的基本信念。
blanket: She put a blanket on the bed.
她在床上放了一條毯子。
buco: buco（osso buco 燉牛膝的一部分）
Osso buco is an Italian dish.
cheese: I put cheese on my pasta.
我在義大利麵上放起司。
cheetah: A cheetah can run very fast.
coming: 來（come 的進行式，where they are coming from 指立場）
He is coming to the meeting.
cozy: This room is warm and cozy.
cream: I like cream in my coffee.
de: 聖修伯里的全名裡有 de。
dean: James Dean was a famous actor.
詹姆斯・狄恩是有名的演員。
doc: 我看了一部自然紀錄片。
ever: Have you ever been to Japan?
experienced: 經歷過（experience 的過去分詞）
exup: Exup is part of his name.
Exup 是他名字的一部分。
followed: 接著、跟隨（follow 的過去式）
A short talk followed the lunch.
午餐後接著有一場短講。
fun: The trip was a lot of fun.
intolerant: 不耐受的（lactose intolerant：乳糖不耐）
james: 詹姆斯今天打電話給我。
kid: I loved cartoons as a kid.
looks: 看起來（look 的第三人稱）
lot: I have a lot to do.
marrow: Bone marrow is rich in flavor.
mean: 意思是、意指（I mean：我是說）
nat: Nat Geo is a famous brand.
oasis: 綠洲合唱團是英國樂團。
obviously: 很明顯，我們需要更多時間。
okay: It's okay to ask for help.
osso: Osso 在義大利文是骨頭。
porowski: 波羅斯基主持一個節目。
prince: The prince lived on a small star.
王子住在一顆小星星上。
reminded: 提醒（remind 的過去式／被動）
I was reminded of my goal.
ry: Ry is part of a name.
scratched: 刮、抓（scratch 的過去式；scratch the surface：只是淺嘗）
serve: This skill will serve you well.
這項技能會對你很有幫助。
show: 我們看了一個料理節目。
side: Put the sauce on the side.
so: It was late, so we left.
時間晚了，所以我們走了。
south: The factory is in the south.
taking: 帶（take 的進行式；taking my dog on a walk：帶狗散步）
terminally: 無可救藥地（terminally unique：獨一無二到無藥可救）
through: 經歷、通過（going through something：正在經歷某事）
We went through a hard time.
我們經歷過一段艱難時期。
unique: 每個設計都是獨一無二的。
virginia: 維吉尼亞（West Virginia：西維吉尼亞州）
Virginia is on the east coast.
walk: We took a walk after lunch.
west: The sun sets in the west.
wild: We saw bears in the wild.
works: 工作、運作（work 的第三人稱）
